description:
Pixel art game background: a cramped, obsessively clean operating room of an unlicensed clinic in a run-down 1990s Seoul underground arcade, night, a harsh surgical lamp.
Camera at standing eye height, about 20 degrees above the floor, looking slightly down. One-point perspective, side walls receding toward the middle. The floor fills the lower 40 percent of the image. Both side walls are visible, a closed room.
FLOOR: blue-grey tiles, dark grout, a drain, mop streaks, a pool of light under the table.
WALLS: white tiles, yellowed grout, chipped tiles, rust drips, steel baseboard; two fluorescent tubes.
THINGS (a standing adult is 150 pixels tall): center: a steel operating table on one pedestal, long side to camera, 190 by 85 pixels, black mattress, straps; above it a two-headed surgical lamp on a ceiling arm; left of the table an IV stand, right of it a monitor on a stand; beside the table two steel trolleys of scalpels and gauze; on the back wall left a steel medicine cabinet, 165 pixels tall, bottles behind glass, chained shut; on the back wall a scrub sink under a rack of glove boxes; on the back wall right a white refrigerator big enough for a person, 170 by 80 pixels; on the back wall a yellow sharps box; in the back corner a red biohazard bin; in front of the fridge two organ cooler boxes; on the right wall a rack of odd mechanical prosthetic limbs and implants; on the left wall a shelf of disinfectant bottles; at the front left an oxygen cylinder and a steel drum with hazard stripes; at the front right a suction machine cart.
LIGHT: bright table under the lamp, greyer walls, deep shadows under cabinets, trolleys and table, glossy steel highlights.
STYLE: dense, highly detailed pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, selective dark outline, rich medium-to-detailed shading, cold greyed white, steel and blue-grey with blue-black shadows and green, yellow, red accents, no dithering, no blur. No people, chairs, sofas, benches, clocks, blood, text, doors or doorways.

style_image.usage_description: pixel size, outline and shading reference only; a character sprite from the same game

reference_images.usage_description: Copy only the camera angle, the low viewing height, the perspective, the pixel density and the level of detail and shading of this image. Do not copy any of its objects, furniture, layout, room shape or colors.
